info.title: Brain local Tasks work log
info.description: Loopback application API. Date boundaries are inclusive ISO calendar dates. Search is literal in titles and details. Summaries and task detail editing use the same persistent store.

200.description: Up to 100 tasks ordered by newest work date, with next_offset, total matching tasks, and counts per status across the whole filtered set.

400.description: Invalid ISO date, reversed range, offset, or status.

id.description: When supplied, update this task; otherwise create.

date.description: Creation work date; defaults to today.

200.description: Persisted task; same-day titles are deduplicated on create.
